div.head: Grið 25
div.ab: ⁊ on hwam mæg huru æfre ænig man on worolde swyðor God wurðian þonne on cyrcan ⁊ on hælnessan ⁊ eft on gehalgedan healican hadan?
And on hwam mæg huru æfre ænig man on worolde swyðor God wurðian þonne on cyrcan and on hælnessan, and eft on gehalgedan healican hadan?
Und worin denn vermag jemals irgendwer in der Welt Gott kräftiger zu verehren als in Kirchen und in Heiligthümern und dann in geweihten erhabenen Klerikern?
And in what, indeed, can anyone in the world ever honour God more strongly than in churches and in sanctuaries and then in consecrated high clerics?
And indeed, where in the world can anyone ever worship God better than in churches and in sanctuaries, and in the high holy orders also?
